Problem 2. Let $( X _ { n } ) _ { n \geq 1 }$ be a sequence of non-negative random variables. Let $( \mathcal { F } _ { n } ) _ { n \geq 1 }$ be a filtration (i.e. a sequence of increasing σ-algebras). Assume that

$$
\mathbb {E} [ X _ {n} \mid \mathcal {F} _ {n} ] \to 0, \quad i n p r o b a b i l i t y.
$$
Is it true reversely? If yes, prove it; if not, give a counterexample.

Problem 3. Let $X _ { 1 } , . . . , X _ { n }$ be independent random variables following common Poisson distribution with mean λ. Let $\eta = e ^ { - \lambda }$ .
